title: EpistemicStatus
description: Epistemic status of a belief combining Spohn's ranking theory with Pollock's warrant semantics. Per ARCH-4 panel consultation (Spohn, Pollock, Haack, 2026-02-12).

rank.description: Spohn rank κ(B): degree of disbelief in B. 0 = not disbelieved (believed). Higher = more disbelieved. IMPORTANT: This is degree of DISBELIEF, not belief. κ(B)=0 means B is believed.

neg_rank.description: Spohn rank κ(¬B): degree of disbelief in negation of B. When neg_rank > rank, B is believed. When rank > neg_rank, B is disbelieved.

firmness.description: Derived: firmness of belief = |rank - neg_rank|. Higher = more firmly held (either believed or disbelieved).

believed.description: Derived: true if neg_rank > rank (B is believed). Convenience field.

warrant_status.description: Pollock warrant status. WARRANTED = justified and undefeated. DEFEATED = has undefeated defeater. SUSPENDED = in a defeat cycle (neither warranted nor defeated). UNGROUNDED = lacks grounding chain to experience.

defeat_info.description: Details about defeat status (present when warrant_status is DEFEATED or SUSPENDED)

defeater_ids.description: IDs of beliefs that defeat this one

defeat_type.description: Type of defeat: REBUTTING attacks conclusion, UNDERCUTTING attacks inference link

attack_point.description: For undercutting defeat: what inference link is attacked

cycle_members.description: For SUSPENDED status: IDs of beliefs in the defeat cycle

prima_facie_warranted.description: Whether this belief is prima facie warranted (before considering defeaters). Per Pollock: observational beliefs and beliefs supported by warranted beliefs are prima facie warranted.

reinstatement_chain.description: If reinstated after defeat, the chain of belief IDs showing how reinstatement occurred

rank_history.description: History of rank changes for debugging and explanation

last_computed.description: When this epistemic status was last computed/updated

SpohnConditionalization.description: Formula for rank update on new evidence E with firmness n: κ_new(B) = min(κ(B|E), κ(B|¬E) + n). Conditional rank: κ(B|E) = κ(B∧E) - κ(E). See Spohn (2012) Laws of Belief.

PollockDefeat.description: Defeat semantics per Pollock (1987, 1995): A defeater for B is a reason to doubt B (rebutting) or to doubt the inference to B (undercutting). Reinstatement: if the defeater is itself defeated, B may be reinstated.
